Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Covers the requirements of poker.

2.1 The tolerances on dimensions shall be in accordance with coarse class of 18:2102-1969. 
'Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified tolerances { first revrs/on )/ 

3. Material 

3.1 B/ade — Shall be spring steel wire conforming to IS ; 4454 (Part I )-1975. 'Specification for 
patented and cold drawn steel wires— unalloyed ( first revision )\ 

3.2 Handle — The handle of poker shall be made of mild steel or any other suitable material like wood 
or plastic, provided it meets the requirements laid down in 6. 

4. Hardness — The blade shall be suitably hardened and tempered to give a hardness of minimum 
45W/?C(=^445//V). 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The blade shall be free from burrs, kinks and other manufacturing defects. It shall be finished 
smooth and bright all over. 

5.2 Blade shall be made o( ciicular cross section with poiDted end. However, tip may be madie of any 
cross section if required by the purchaser, The working end of the blade shall be ground sharp and 
tapered as shown in Fig in 2.

5.3 The blade shall be affixed to the handle in such a way that it is not liable to come out during use 
and the blade shall not rotate on the handle. The surface of the handre shall be finished smooth, free 
from burrs and sharp edges. The handle shall be convenient for holding. 

5.4 The blade and the metallic handle of the polcer shall be protected aginst rust by plating with 
niclcie, chromium or zinc; or by any other suitable anticorrosive treatment. In case of wooden handles 
only ferrule cap shall be provided and a clear polish or lacquer shall be applied to the wooden handles 
to give a good finish. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Pierce the poker through a thickness of 200 sheets of super calender paper by using force or 
impact. The piercing shall be neat and clean and the poker shall not be bent or damaged. 

6.2 Keeping the working end of the poker on a wooden block of medium hardness, strike 5 normal 
blows with a 500 g hammer on the handle. The poker shall not show any sign of damage and also 
the blade shall not enter the handle more than 2 mm after the test. 

7. Sampling — To ascertain the conformity of the lot to the requirements of this standard, the 
procedure for sampling as given in IS : 2500 (Part I )-1 973 'Sampling inspection table; Part f 
Inspection by attributes and counts of defects' shall be followed. The sampling plan, inspection level 
and aceeptable quality level to be followed for various characteristics shall be according to 7.1 and 7.2, 

7.1 For workmanship, finish and dimension, single sampling plan with inspection level 111 and 
Acceptable Quality Level 4 percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 (Part I )-1 973 shall 
be adopted. 

7.2 For hardness and tests, the sampling plan with inspection level I and Acceptable Quality Level 2, 5 
percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part I )-1973 shall be adopted. 

8. Marking — Each poker shall be clearly, legibly and indelibly marked on the handle with the 
manufacturer's name, initials and/or recognized trade-mark and overall length. 

8.1 iSi Certification Maricing — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

9. Packing — According to the best trade practices prevailing in the industry or as agreed to between 
the manufacturer and the purchaser. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard deals with the requirements of pokers which are commonly used ds punch pokers. 
The poker can also be used as an ice pick for cutting ice slabs or as a book binders' bodkin.
